knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Loose debris is removed dry first, so the least water is needed for the damp step.
Water and product must stay away from the membrane panel, vents and electrical connections.
Abrasive pads scratch stainless steel and make soil stick more easily.
Wiping along the grain with a stainless-approved product gives a clean finish without scratches.
Drying and checking for residue prevents streaks, moisture at seams and long-term damage.

practicalCriteria: Removes loose debris dry before applying a damp product
Keeps water and product away from vents, seals, controls, connections and labels
Wipes stainless steel along the grain without abrasive pads
Dries and checks the surface for residue and moisture before handover
passRule: Knowledge checks: at least 4 of 5 correct (80%). Practical sign-off is separate: an assessor observes the practical criteria and records the result. A knowledge pass is not practical competence and does not grant any licence or authority.
evidenceRequired: Method and product record for each surface
Record of any part excluded because the manufacturer forbids wetting
Before and after photographs where the business requires them
stopWorkCriteria: Hosing or pressure washing of the exterior
Use of steel wool or scouring pads on stainless steel
Water found inside a control panel or vent after the clean
